items.title: Invitation to bid for up to £75,000 to improve community paediatric waiting times
items.summary: GIRFT is inviting NHS-commissioned community paediatric service providers in England to express interest in bidding for up to £75,000 of funding to improve waiting times for community paediatric services.

items.title: Provisional childhood vaccine coverage in England: July 2026
items.summary: UKHSA's monthly provisional estimates from GP data for MMRV, rotavirus, MenB, the 6-in-1 and the dTaP/IPV booster in July 2026. Supplements the official COVER statistics to give immunisation teams more timely figures; local authority figures vary because cohorts are small.

items.title: Childhood vaccination coverage (COVER) April to June 2026: 12-month coverage slips
items.summary: UKHSA's COVER data for Q1 2026/27: in England 12-month coverage fell to 89.2% for the 6-in-1, 89.5% for PCV1 and 87.6% for rotavirus, while MenB rose to 91.4%. Coverage stays below its 10-year peaks and is lowest in London and deprived areas.

items.title: Pertussis in England: 71 confirmed cases in January to March 2026
items.summary: UKHSA confirmed 71 whooping cough cases in Q1 2026, similar to Q4 2025 (77) and far below Q1 2025 (328), as the 2024 cyclical peak continues to recede. 79% were aged 15 or over; 3 were infants, one under 3 months. Infant under-3-month cases fell from 433 in 2024 to 12 in 2025.

items.title: Jiraffe relaunches children's postural care range after demand
items.summary: THIIS reported that Jiraffe's postural care range for children with cerebral palsy and similar conditions has returned following demand, restoring clinician access to those products.
